subject: LyraMed pilot expansion — incentive package request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LyraMed pilot expansion — incentive package request

Hi Marissa / Vivek,

Quick summary and ask: LyraMed (healthcare analytics startup) wants to expand the current 6-week pilot into a 90-day production pilot across 3 clinical bundles. They've signaled willingness to move to a paid pilot if we provide a combined incentive: credits to offset token spend during the pilot plus a short-term extension and a price concession on the first-year subscription.

Why it matters: converting this pilot likely drives ~$220k ARR within 12 months (initial seat/license + ingestion fees + professional services). Strategic value — strong reference in the payer analytics vertical; they run HIPAA-sensitive workloads, so Private deployment will be part of the scope.

What I'm asking for signoff on (final proposal below):
- $60,000 in platform credits applied to pilot/first-months (pre-paid credit redemption)
- 3-month extension of the pilot (total 90 days)
- 20% list discount on Year 1 subscription if they commit to $120k net new spend within 6 months of pilot close
- Complimentary onboarding (up to 40 engineer-hours) and one expedited SOC2 readiness review session

Risks / mitigation: we should condition credits on an MoA that ties credits to usage within the pilot and a minimum commit clause. Finance margins are compressed but we expect 40% net retention beyond year 1 with upsell. Attaching the usage forecast and the draft MOA for review.

Timing: the customer wants terms by Wednesday EOD (2027-03-17) to align procurement and legal cycles.

Attachments: LyraMed_Pilot_MOA.pdf; LyraMed_usage_forecast.xlsx

If you need an alternate structure, I can propose a smaller credit + higher commit threshold.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LyraMed pilot expansion — incentive package request
Diego,

Thanks for the write-up — appreciate the urgency. A few quick items before I can green-light: 
- ARR math: how confident are you on the $220k figure? please send a 12-month revenue waterfall.
- Margin impact: what's the expected gross margin after the credit & discount? need finance to sign off.
- Conditions: strongly prefer credits tied to usage and a defined commit. no open-ended write-offs.

If you can reframe to $45k credits + 20% discount contingent on $120k committed spend, that might be approvable. Also, can you get procurement to agree to a 60-day payment SLA post-signature? That reduces risk for us.

Looping Vivek for directional approval.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise - Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 13:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LyraMed pilot expansion — incentive package request
Marissa — thanks, agree on tying credits to commit. Updated ask below (I discussed with Anna & procurement on call this morning):

Final proposed structure (customer-facing):
- $45,000 in platform credits (applied to pilot and first 60 days of production); credits expire after 180 days.
- 90-day pilot (extension) with standard data handling annex for Private deployment.
- 20% discount off list for Year 1 if LyraMed signs a $120k minimum net-new subscription within 6 months of pilot sign-off. Credits are contingent on executing the MoA and meeting a minimum 60% usage threshold in pilot months.
- Complimentary onboarding: up to 30 engineer-hours; additional hours billed at our standard PS rate.
Revenue/margin snapshot: expected first-year revenue $165k (post-discount) with projected gross margin ~48% after credits/PS discounts (finance calc attached). We believe lifetime value > $500k with typical vertical expansion.
Customer sentiment: Anna Reyes (Dir. of Analytics) reiterated that the credit + discount is a gating item for their legal to prioritize us; procurement wants the commit to avoid internal override.
Attachments: MAAP_v2.pdf (usage & retention), SOW_Draft.docx
If this passes your review, can we get a provisional sign-off by EOD so I can send the terms to legal & procurement?
Thanks,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LyraMed pilot expansion — incentive package request
Diego / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear proposal. Directionally I am okay with this structure provided two guardrails:
1) Credits must be escrowed/conditional and explicitly expire (no open-ended credits).
2) Commit must be legally enforceable (signed subscription with minimum payment clause).

Ask Finance to model the worst-case scenario (no conversion) so we understand downside. If the model is acceptable, I give provisional approval to proceed with the $45k credit + 20% discount tied to $120k commit.

Marissa — please start the finance & legal loop; Monica please prepare a scoped SOW and the onboarding resource plan. Diego, aim to get procurement agreement on payment SLA and the usage thresholds.
-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Anna Reyes <anna.reyes@lyramed.com>, Dan Kim <procurement@lyramed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Mar 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Final pilot terms — LyraMed (provisional approval received)
Anna / Dan —

Thanks for the productive conversations. Per our internal review we can move forward with the following terms (provisionally approved by Redwood leadership, pending final legal/finance):

- Credits: $45,000 in platform credits applied to pilot and first 60 days of production; credits expire 180 days from signature.
- Pilot: 90 days total. Private deployment annex to be included in SOW.
- Discount: 20% off Year 1 list price if LyraMed signs a minimum $120,000 net-new subscription within 6 months of pilot completion.
- Onboarding: up to 30 engineer-hours included; additional professional services outside scope will be quoted.
- Payment term request: 60 days net from invoice (LyraMed procurement requested this; Redwood finance to confirm).
Next steps:
1) I will send a draft MoA / SOW for review (attached: SOW_Draft.docx).
2) If OK, legal can route the subscription with the commit clause; we'll include the usage threshold in the MoA.
3) DocuSign placeholder: DocuSign://envelope/ABC-123-PLACEHOLDER
Anna — can you confirm procurement timing and whether your legal needs any additional clauses for data residency / SOC2 attestation? If yes, loop your legal contact and I will have our security/compliance team respond.
Thanks everyone — will keep the thread updated as we get finance/legal signoffs.
Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Diego.Fernandez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
--
Attachments (stubs): SOW_Draft.docx (Microsoft Word doc, 78 KB)
